mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM photo_album pa LEFT JOIN photo p ON p.album_id = pa.id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE pa.status = 1 AND pa.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY pa.id, pa.name, pa.description, pa.cover_url, pa.sort_order, pa.status, pa.created_at, pa.updated_at ORDER BY pa.sort_order ASC, pa.id ASC

SELECT
FROM photo_album pa LEFT JOIN photo p ON p.album_id = pa.id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE pa.id = #{albumId} AND pa.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY pa.id, pa.name, pa.description, pa.cover_url, pa.sort_order, pa.status, pa.created_at, pa.updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE photo SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE album_id = #{albumId} AND is_deleted = 0
